ds.title: Shared UI primitives
ds.intro: Reusable building blocks for the RI'AYA backoffice. These live in src/common and will be reused by future clinic modules.
ds.modalBody: This is a reusable dialog with a title, body, and actions. Use it for confirmations and short forms.
ds.tokensIntro: Every token below is read from the token module, so this table cannot drift from the stylesheet.
ds.formsIntro: Inputs, selects and pickers. Every control shares one shell with a 40px minimum target and an aria-invalid state.
ds.fieldHelp: Shown in the schedule and on receipts.
ds.navigationIntro: Tabs, menus, popovers and dialogs. All of them move focus predictably and close on Escape.
ds.tabUpcomingBody: Arrow keys move between tabs, Home and End jump to the ends.
ds.tabPastBody: Only the selected panel is rendered.
ds.popoverBody: Panels flip and shift so they stay inside the window.
ds.tooltipText: Tooltips appear on hover and on focus, and dismiss with Escape.
ds.confirmBody: The patient will be notified and the slot released to the waiting list.
ds.dataIntro: Cards, tables, charts and loading placeholders.
ds.feedbackIntro: Toasts appear in the corner and are announced politely.
ds.statesIntro: Empty and error states pair an icon with a message and an optional action.
ds.errorBody: Check your connection and try again.
